description: This file defines the SchedulersViewList class, which extends ViewList, and customizes the display method to show cron instructions based on options. It appears to be part of the SuiteCRM module's view layer for scheduled tasks listing.

classes.name: SchedulersViewList
classes.description: A view class for listing scheduled tasks, extending the generic ViewList, with custom display logic.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to include optional cron instructions display depending on options.
